cohort: The study analyzed symptom data from 13,933 patient self-assessment questionnaires.
finding: The study identified the top 20 predictors of endometriosis, including Cesarean section, ovarian cysts, and hernia, with the final machine learning model achieving an AUC of 0.82 on the testing dataset for endometriosis prediction.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as one of the top 20 predictors of endometriosis.
